Package com.helix.core.ml

Class OnnxModelExecutor

java.lang.Object
com.helix.core.ml.OnnxModelExecutor
public final class OnnxModelExecutor extends Object
Static runtime bridge for executing ONNX model inference from compiled JVM bytecode and interpreters.

Provides high-performance static dispatch methods invoked directly by compiled rule classes via INVOKESTATIC, delegating to the globally active OnnxSessionPool.
